title: Committee of Supply – Head L (Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment)
what_it_is: Committee of Supply – Head L (Ministry of Sustainability and the Environment)

sections.label: Budget cut for Head L
sections.summary: A motion is moved to reduce the total sum allocated for Head L of the Estimates by $100.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, I beg to move, "That the total sum to be allocated for Head L of the Estimates be reduced by $100".

sections.label: Extended Producer Responsibility and related schemes
sections.summary: The Extended Producer Responsibility, disposable carrier bag charge and Deposit Refund Scheme are steps in the right direction responding to activists' calls.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang (Nee Soon)
sentences.text: The Extended Producer Responsibility, the upcoming disposable carrier bag charge, the Deposit Refund Scheme are all steps in the right direction and positively respond to the calls by so many activists who have called for these for many years.

sections.label: Green Plan key targets
sections.summary: The Green Plan's key targets include parks, reduced consumption, green commutes, energy, infrastructure, economy, coastal protection and local food, and an update is sought.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: The key targets include development of parks and green spaces; reduction of waste, water and electricity consumption; green commutes; green energy; greener infrastructure and buildings, sustainable towns and districts; a green economy with green investments and jobs; coastal protection from sea-level rise and enhanced flood resilience and meeting 30% of Singapore's nutritional needs through locally produced food by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Would the Minister provide an update on the progress of the Green Plan?

sections.label: GreenGov.SG public sector targets
sections.summary: Under GreenGov.SG, the public sector strives to attain ambitious sustainability targets in carbon abatement and resource efficiency.

sentences.speaker: Prof Koh Lian Pin (Nominated Member)
sentences.text: Under GreenGov.SG, the public sector strives to attain ambitious sustainability targets in carbon abatement and resource efficiency.

sections.label: GreenGov.SG launch and carbon peak
sections.summary: In 2021 the public sector launched GreenGov.SG to lead sustainable national development, aiming to peak its carbon emissions around 2025, ahead of the national target.

sentences.speaker: Mr Don Wee (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: In 2021, the public sector launched GreenGov.SG to lead Singapore's pursuit of sustainable national development, as laid out in the Singapore Green Plan 2030.

sentences.speaker: Mr Don Wee (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: Under GreenGov.SG, the public sector aims to peak its carbon emissions around 2025, ahead of the national target.

sections.label: Sustainability in Government tenders
sections.summary: The Government will factor in companies' sustainability-related policies and practices when evaluating Government tenders, including event venues, accommodation and public waste collection contracts.

sentences.speaker: Mr Don Wee (Chua Chu Kang)
sentences.text: The Government will factor in companies' sustainability-related policies and practices when evaluating Government tenders, including event venues, accommodation, public waste collection contracts and so on.

sections.label: SGX mandatory climate disclosures
sections.summary: SGX has rolled out mandatory climate disclosure requirements for issuers in the financial, energy and agriculture, food and forest products industries.

sentences.speaker: Mr Don Wee
sentences.text: Chairman, the Singapore Exchange (SGX) has rolled out mandatory climate disclosures requirements, starting with issuers in the financial, energy and agriculture, food and forest products industries, based on the recommendations of the Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Don Wee
sentences.text: Are there plans for the public sector to do likewise?

sections.label: SGX climate disclosures timeline
sections.summary: From FY 2023, climate disclosures are mandatory for public-listed companies under SGX, beginning with specific sectors, with more sectors from FY 2024.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: From FY 2023, it is mandatory for public-listed companies under the Singapore Exchange (SGX) beginning with specific sectors to make climate disclosures.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: More sectors will be included from FY 2024.

sections.label: Carbon Pricing Amendment Bill passed
sections.summary: The Carbon Pricing (Amendment) Bill was passed in November 2022.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: The Carbon Pricing (Amendment) Bill was passed in November 2022.

sections.label: Allowance volume clarification request
sections.summary: A request for the Minister to clarify the estimated volume of allowances the Government plans to issue under the transition framework.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling (East Coast)
sentences.text: On the provisioning of allowances, could the Minister clarify the estimated volume of allowances the Government is planning to issue as part of the transition framework?

sections.label: Household energy efficiency and SME help
sections.summary: Asks what help the Ministry can provide households to be more energy-efficient and save on electricity bills, noting Singapore's over 290,000 SMEs.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: What help can the Ministry provide to households to be more energy-efficient and save on their electricity bills?

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh (Ang Mo Kio)
sentences.text: We have over 290,000 small- and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in Singapore, employing two thirds of our workforce and contributing to half of our Gross Domestic Product (GDP).

sections.label: Singapore household electricity consumption data
sections.summary: Household electricity consumption rose nearly 33% from 6.6 gigawatt hours in 2012 to 8.2 gigawatt hours in 2021, with breakdowns by housing type and use.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Chairman, according to the data from Singapore Department of Statistics and the Energy Market Authority (EMA), our household electricity consumption in Singapore rose nearly 33% from 6.6 gigawatt hours in 2012 to 8.2 gigawatt hours in 2021.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: Households account for about 15% of total electricity consumption, with public housing accounting for 60% and private residential accounting for 40%.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak (Sembawang)
sentences.text: For each household, the main uses of electricity are in three categories: environmental control, 49%; household appliances, 45%; and personal devices, 6%.

sections.label: NEWater and DTSS Phase 2
sections.summary: PUB aims to raise NEWater supply capacity by up to 55% of demand by 2060, and DTSS Phase 2 tunnelling was about 80% complete as of April 2022.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San
sentences.text: The Public Utilities Board (PUB) has the ambitious goal of increasing NEWater supply capacity by up to 55% of demand by 2060.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San
sentences.text: The tunnelling works for the Deep Tunnel Sewerage System (DTSS) Phase 2 was about 80% completed as of April 2022.

sections.label: Recycling bin contamination concern
sections.summary: At a Marsiling-Yew Tee GRC Green Action for Community deep dive session, members discussed concern over high contamination rates of recycling bins.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hany Soh (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: During the recent Marsiling-Yew Tee GRC's Green Action for Community's (GAC) deep dive session, one of the topics which was discussed among the GAC members is the concern for high contamination rates of recycling bins.

sections.label: Reducing recyclable contamination and household waste
sections.summary: The passage asks what further measures the Ministry can introduce to reduce recyclable contamination in blue bins and what efforts encourage households to reduce waste.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hany Soh (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: What other measures can the Ministry further introduce to reduce the contamination of recyclables in the blue bins?

sentences.speaker: Ms Hany Soh (Marsiling-Yew Tee)
sentences.text: In this regard, what are some of the efforts made by the Ministry to encourage households to reduce waste?

sections.label: E-waste EPR scheme update
sections.summary: The passage asks whether the Ministry can update on whether the e-waste EPR scheme, two years after implementation, has increased e-waste recycling rates.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: Given that it has been two years since the e-waste EPR was implemented, can the Ministry provide an update whether the scheme has been successful in increasing e-waste recycling rates?

sections.label: Disposable carrier bag charge roadmap
sections.summary: The passage asks whether the Government can provide a roadmap for expanding the disposable carrier bag charge so people and businesses can prepare.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: Can the Government provide a roadmap for the expansion of the disposable carrier bag charge so that people and businesses know where we are heading towards and can prepare for it?

sections.label: Hawker food prices and stall rentals
sections.summary: The passage raises incomprehension over 50-cent to a dollar food increases outstripping government taxes, subsidies or business costs, and asks whether more hawker centres mean lower stallholder rental or a tweaked bidding model.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: The increment of 50 cents to a dollar on food each time is something that they cannot comprehend as they felt that the percentage increase by the stalls always outstrip the increases in the Government taxes, the Government subsidies or the associated business costs.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: With more new hawker centres being built, with Bukit Panjang and Bukit Canberra being the newest additions, will more hawker centres imply a lower rental cost to stallholders or does the current bidding model for our stalls still need to be tweaked?

sections.label: Hawker centre rentals and NEA
sections.summary: Asks whether hawker centre rentals have risen with inflation and how NEA keeps them reasonable.

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: Have their rentals been increasing in tandem during this period of inflationary pressures?

sentences.speaker: Ms Joan Pereira (Tanjong Pagar)
sentences.text: How does the National Environment Agency (NEA) ensure that rentals at hawker centres remain reasonable?

sections.label: Hawker versus food court prices
sections.summary: States the price gap between a $3.50 hawker plate and a $7.00 food court plate matters to those on limited budgets.

sentences.speaker: Mr Pritam Singh (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The difference between a $3.50 hawker centre plate of food and a $7.00 food court plate means a great deal to those on a limited budget.

sections.label: Hawker support schemes and UNESCO listing
sections.summary: Lists hawker grants and programmes, notes the 2020 UNESCO inscription, and asks about the Productive Hawker Centres Programme.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
sentences.text: It is heartening to hear of the initiatives and grants made available to hawkers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
sentences.text: We have the Hawkers’ Productivity Grant subsidising automation equipment and technological solutions for individual hawkers; the Hawkers’ Development Programme complementing classroom training with an apprenticeship stint with a veteran hawker; the Incubation Stall Programme offering subsidised rentals to new entrants; we also have the Hawkers Succession Scheme facilitating the transfer of hawker stalls and recipes from retiring veterans to aspiring hawkers.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
sentences.text: Chairman, in 2020, Singapore’s Hawker Culture is inscribed onto the UNESCO Representative List of the Intangible Cultural Heritage of Humanity.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
sentences.text: It is imperative that we continue to support our hawkers and Singaporean hawker culture.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam (Jurong)
sentences.text: Therefore, I would like to ask the Minister about the progress and take-up rate of the Productive Hawker Centres Programme, launched in 2017, as well as whether NEA is considering additional measures to continue to futureproof our hawker centres.

sections.label: Imported food and 30 by 30
sections.summary: States over 90% of food is imported from some 170 countries and that the 30 by 30 strategy aims for 30% local production by 2030.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: More than 90% of our food is imported from some 170 countries.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: Certainly, due to natural constraints, we may not be able to significantly reduce this reliance on imported food, but we have since 2019 been working to increase self-production in accordance with the “30 by 30” strategy.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: That is, we hope to meet 30% of our nutritional needs locally by 2030, up from the less than 10% today.

sections.label: 30 by 30 and aquaculture sector
sections.summary: Calls the 30 by 30 goal a step forward and notes 2022 COS efforts to transform aquaculture, including licence fee reduction.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: Singapore’s "30 by 30" goal is definitely a step in the right direction, leveraging agri-tech to help production in eggs, seafood and vegetables to meet the Singapore Green Plan 2030 targets.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: In the 2022 Committee of Supply (COS), there was an effort to transform the aquaculture sector – from providing existing farmers with Temporary Occupation Licences to reducing the farm culture licence fee.

sections.label: Sea level rise and platform heights
sections.summary: Notes 30% of the island is under five metres above the Singapore Height Datum and asks how often the five to 5.5 metre platform measurement is reviewed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: As a low-lying island with 30% of our island being less than five metres above the Singapore Height Datum which is used as a reference for height measurement, rising sea levels pose the most immediate threat to us.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: If we take into account the compounding effects of mean sea level rise of one metre by 2100 as projected by PUB, sea levels could potentially go up by four to five metres if we include other activities such as storm surges and land subsidence.

sentences.speaker: Mr Edward Chia Bing Hui (Holland-Bukit Timah)
sentences.text: First, with the proposed plans of raising platforms for new critical infrastructure to be at least five to 5.5 metres above the mean sea level, how often will this measurement be reviewed by MSE?

sections.label: Singapore sea level rise projections
sections.summary: Singapore's average sea level is projected to rise up to one metre in about 80 years, or four to five metres with other effects.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: The average sea level around Singapore is projected to rise by up to one metre in about 80 years' time.

sentences.speaker: Dr Lim Wee Kiak
sentences.text: As studies show, sea levels could rise up to four to five metres, if we take into account other effects: (a) the mean sea level rise of one metre phenomenal as well as daily tidal activities occurring twice a day; (b) storm surges where on average Singapore experiences two to four each year; as well as (c) land subsidence due to tectonic movements.

sections.label: Heavy rainfall and drainage study
sections.summary: Singapore had its heaviest rainfall in 30 years, and PUB announced a 2023 study on an underground drainage and reservoir system.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San
sentences.text: A case in point, we experienced the heaviest rainfall yesterday in 30 years of 225.5 millimetres of daily total rainfall.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San
sentences.text: In January this year, PUB announced that a study to assess the feasibility of using an underground drainage and reservoir system to combat inland and coastal flooding will start in 2023.

sections.label: Dengue cases in 2022
sections.summary: In 2022 there were more than 32,000 dengue cases, about six times the number recorded in 2021.

sentences.speaker: Ms Poh Li San
sentences.text: In 2022, there were more than 32,000 dengue cases in 2022 and about six times the total number of cases recorded in 2021.

sections.label: NEA warning on dengue cases
sections.summary: NEA said in December that a rise in dengue cases could mean Singapore enters this year with an atypically large number of cases.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The National Environment Agency (NEA) said in December that a rise in the high number of dengue cases at the end of the year could result in Singapore entering this year with an atypically large number of dengue cases.

sections.label: Smaller phases suppress Aedes mosquitoes
sections.summary: The earliest smaller phases have shown positive results in suppressing Aedes aegypti mosquitoes and reducing dengue cases in Tampines and Yishun.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The earliest smaller phases have shown positive results in drastically suppressing the Aedes aegypti mosquito population and reducing the number of dengue cases, for example, in Tampines and Yishun.

sections.label: Takeda dengue vaccine Takoo 3
sections.summary: The most advanced is a dengue vaccine by Takeda, Takoo 3, a tetravalent vaccine targeting all four dengue serotypes.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sylvia Lim (Aljunied)
sentences.text: The most advanced of these is a dengue vaccine by Takeda, Takoo 3 – a tetravalent vaccine targeting all four dengue serotypes.

sections.label: Wolbachia mosquito releases in HDB blocks
sections.summary: NEA data shows Aedes aegypti populations fall up to 98% after Wolbachia-Aedes releases, and 1,400 more HDB blocks will be covered from July 2022.

sentences.speaker: Mr Gan Thiam Poh
sentences.text: Chairman, NEA's data has shown that after a few months of Wolbachia-Aedes mosquito releases, the population of the Aedes aegypti mosquito falls by up to 98%.

sentences.speaker: Ms Hany Soh
sentences.text: In June last year, Minister Grace Fu announced at the Asia Dengue Summit that NEA will be releasing male Wolbachia-Aedes mosquitoes in 1,400 additional HDB blocks across Singapore from July 2022.

sections.label: GreenGov.SG net-zero emissions commitment
sections.summary: Under GreenGov.SG, the public sector committed to net-zero emissions around 2045, five years ahead of the national target.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Under the GreenGov.SG initiative, the public sector has committed to achieving net-zero emissions around 2045, five years ahead of our national target.

sections.label: PUB desalination energy efficiency target
sections.summary: PUB will improve energy-intensive processes and targets reducing desalination energy consumption from 3.5 to under 2 kilowatt-hour per cubic meter by 2025.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: First, PUB will reduce carbon emissions by improving the efficiency of energy-intensive processes such as desalination and NEWater.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: It targets to reduce the energy consumption for desalination from 3.5 to less than 2 kilowatt-hour per cubic meter by 2025.

sections.label: Annual GreenGov.SG report publication
sections.summary: From this financial year onwards, the Government will publish an annual GreenGov.SG report showing efforts, progress and plans.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Mr Don Wee and Miss Cheryl Chan will be pleased to hear that from this financial year onwards, the Government will publish an annual GreenGov.SG report, the report will show our efforts, progress and plans.

sections.label: Sustainability in government procurement tenders
sections.summary: From 2024, besides environmental standards, the sustainability practices of companies will be considered, starting with large construction and ICT tenders.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Starting from 2024, besides pre-qualifying the products on environmental standards, we will also consider the sustainability practices of the company we buy from.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: As announced by Senior Minister of State for Finance, Mr Chee Hong Tat, we will start with large construction and ICT tenders.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: These make up more than 60% of the value of Government procurement contracts.

sections.label: Evaluation points for environmental sustainability
sections.summary: As this is a new concept, up to 5% of evaluation points will be set aside for environmental sustainability.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: As this is a new concept, we will start with setting aside up to 5% of the evaluation points for environmental sustainability.

sections.label: International carbon credits offset
sections.summary: Companies may use high-quality international carbon credits to offset up to 5% of taxable emissions, with a whitelist to be published later this year.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: As raised by Prof Koh, we will allow companies to use high-quality international carbon credits or ICCs, to offset up to 5% of their taxable emissions.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We will publish a whitelist of acceptable ICCs later this year, which will include eligible host countries, carbon crediting programmes and methodologies.

sections.label: E2F funded energy retrofit
sections.summary: The E2F funded 70% of a $60,000 project cost, and the company enjoyed annual energy savings of about $30,000.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The E2F funded 70% of the $60,000 project cost.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: With these retrofits, the company improved the energy efficiency of its operations.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: They enjoyed annual energy savings of about $30,000 which represents a payback period of less than a year with support from the E2F.

sections.label: Climate Friendly Households Programme
sections.summary: The Climate Friendly Households Programme was introduced in 2020 to help 1- to 3-room HDB households offset the higher cost of efficient appliances.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: Some families may have difficulty making the payment.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We introduced the Climate Friendly Households (CFH) Programme in 2020 to help households in 1- to 3-room HDB flats offset the higher cost of energy- and water-efficient household appliances.

sections.label: Climate voucher offsets appliance cost
sections.summary: The $150 climate voucher could offset most of the higher cost of the 3-tick model, on top of electricity bill savings.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: With the $150 climate voucher, they could offset most of the higher cost of the 3-tick model, on top of further savings in their monthly electricity bill.

sections.label: Extending Climate Friendly Households Programme
sections.summary: Eligible households are urged to use climate vouchers, and the programme's eligibility criteria will be extended and expanded, with details later this year.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: I urge eligible households to tap on the climate vouchers to switch to more efficient appliances and fittings.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We will be extending and expanding the eligibility criteria of the Climate Friendly Households Programme.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: More details on the programme's extension, as well as the list of eligible appliances, will be released later this year, likely to be effective in the following financial year.

sections.label: Green Nation Pledges made
sections.summary: More than 350 educational institutions and organisations representing 200,000 employees and students, and more than 10,000 individuals, have made Green Nation Pledges.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: More than 350 educational institutions and organisations representing 200,000 employees and students and more than 10,000 individuals have made Green Nation Pledges thus far.

sections.label: DTSS used water infrastructure
sections.summary: The DTSS will halve land needed for used water infrastructure, with Phase 2 tunnelling and Tuas WRP and NEWater Factory due by 2026.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: When completed, the DTSS will reduce by 50% the amount of land that would otherwise have been needed for used water infrastructure.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: This is significant in land-scarce Singapore and will make room for more spaces for Singaporeans to live, work and play.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: We are making good progress on DTSS Phase 2 and expect tunnelling works to be completed by the second half of this year.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: The Tuas WRP will be completed by 2026, alongside the new Tuas NEWater Factory.

sections.label: Mandatory water recycling requirements
sections.summary: PUB will impose mandatory recycling requirements on new and expansion projects in high water consumption industries.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: To further improve water efficiency in the non-domestic sector, PUB will introduce mandatory recycling requirements on new and expansion projects in industries that have high water consumption.

sections.label: Enhanced recycling incentive schemes
sections.summary: PUB will enhance incentive schemes encouraging companies to exceed the mandatory recycling rate, effective 1 January 2024.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: PUB will also enhance the incentive schemes to encourage companies to go beyond the mandatory recycling rate.

sentences.speaker: ﻿The Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien)
sentences.text: This will come into effect on 1 January 2024.

sections.label: E-waste collection points and rates
sections.summary: E-waste collection points rose from 300 to over 700, ALBA collected over 9,000 tonnes, and ICT equipment, batteries and lamps collection rate is under 4%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Since then, we have more than doubled the number of nationwide e-waste collection points, from 300 to over 700 today.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: To date, ALBA, the appointed Producer Responsibility Scheme operator, has collected more than 9,000 tonnes of e-waste.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Since 1 July 2021, for Information Communication Technology (ICT) equipment, batteries and lamps, the collection rate is under 4%.

sections.label: Disposable carrier bag charge
sections.summary: From 3 July 2023, supermarket operators with annual turnover over $100 million must charge at least five cents per disposable carrier bag at SFA-licensed outlets.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: From Monday, 3 July 2023, supermarket operators with a company-level annual turnover of more than $100 million will be required to charge at least five cents per disposable carrier bag at their Singapore Food Agency (SFA)-licensed supermarket outlets.

sections.label: Beverage container return scheme
sections.summary: The scheme covers plastic bottles and metal cans of 150 to 3,000 millilitres for all pre-packaged beverages.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: The scheme will cover plastic bottles and metal cans of volumes ranging from 150 to 3,000 millilitres, for all types of pre-packaged beverages.

sections.label: Beverage container return scheme target
sections.summary: NEA will set an 80% return rate target on the scheme operator at steady state, expecting about 800 million plastic bottles and metal cans returned annually.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: For Singapore's beverage container return scheme, NEA will set an 80% return rate target on the scheme operator at steady state.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: With this, we expect about 800 million plastic bottles and metal cans to be returned for recycling annually.

sections.label: Recyclables contamination rate
sections.summary: Mr Gan and Ms Hany Soh spoke on the contamination rate of recyclables, which is about 40%.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Mr Gan and Ms Hany Soh spoke on the contamination rate of recyclables, which is about 40%.

sections.label: Twenty new hawker centres
sections.summary: The Government had announced plans to build 20 new hawker centres, prioritising new estates and relatively under-served heartland estates.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: The Government had previously announced plans to build 20 new hawker centres, prioritising new estates and existing estates in the heartlands that are relatively under-served, in terms of affordable dining options.

sections.label: Upgrading 25 existing hawker centres
sections.summary: 25 existing hawker centres will be upgraded, including Holland Village Market and Food Centre and North Bridge Road Market and Food Centre.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Besides these new centres, to enable our patrons to enjoy their meals in a pleasant and well-ventilated environment, we will also upgrade 25 existing hawker centres, including Holland Village Market and Food Centre and North Bridge Road Market and Food Centre.

sections.label: Median rental of cooked food stalls
sections.summary: Median rental across non-subsidised cooked food stalls has remained constant at about $1,250 per month since 2018.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Median rental across our non-subsidised cooked food stalls has remained constant at about $1,250 per month since 2018.

sections.label: Expanding HPG digital solutions
sections.summary: HPG will be expanded to include stall-level digital solutions, with co-funding maintained at 80%, claimable amount raised to $7,000, and funding extended to March 2026.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: We will be expanding the HPG to include stall-level digital solutions such as e-ordering solutions which are becoming more widespread.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: We will maintain the co-funding quantum at 80% but will increase the total claimable amount from $5,000 to $7,000 per stallholder.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: The funding period will also be extended to March 2026.

sections.label: Co-funding cleaning deployment costs
sections.summary: The measure reduces cleaners' workload, especially at peak hours, with up to 80% co-funding of deployment costs for CPA solutions.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: This will reduce cleaners' workload especially during peak hours.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: We will co-fund up to 80% of deployment costs incurred by the cleaning operator for CPA solutions.

sections.label: Apprenticeship extension option
sections.summary: Participants may extend their apprenticeship by four more weeks beyond the current eight weeks.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: Participants can have the option to extend their apprenticeship by four more weeks, on top of the current eight weeks.

sections.label: Green nation and hawker culture
sections.summary: The Government cannot build a green nation alone, and everyone is urged to adopt sustainable practices and support hawkers.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: The Government cannot build a green nation alone.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan)
sentences.text: I urge everyone to incorporate sustainable practices into your daily routines, starting with the three Rs and support our hawkers to sustain our hawker culture.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: Mr Chairman, as a low-lying tropical island state that imports most of our food, food security, sea level rise and inland flooding are critical concerns.

sections.label: Food import source diversification
sections.summary: Import source diversification has raised food supply sources from 172 in 2019 to 183, with new accredited sources for chicken and eggs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: A core strategy is import source diversification for our key food items.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: We have increased our number of food supply sources from 172 countries and regions in 2019 to 183 countries today.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: We have accredited Indonesia as a new source of chilled, frozen and processed chicken meat.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: So we now have 25 accredited countries for chicken imports.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: We have also approved Brunei as a new source of eggs, and we now have 17 countries accredited to export hen shell eggs to Singapore, up from just 12 in 2019.

sections.label: 30 by 30 food goal
sections.summary: The Government is pressing with the 30 by 30 goal to sustainably produce 30% of nutritional needs locally by 2030.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: We saw how Singaporeans readily switched to frozen chicken when Malaysian fresh chicken imports were disrupted last year.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Sustainability and the Environment (Dr Koh Poh Koon)
sentences.text: I want to assure Dr Lim Wee Kiak that Government is pressing with our "30 by 30" goal of building Singapore's capability and capacity to sustainably produce 30% of our nutritional needs locally by 2030.

sections.label: Study for LCK development
sections.summary: A multi-disciplinary consultancy study will holistically plan the development of LCK and the adjoining West Johor Strait.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: A multi-disciplinary consultancy study will holistically plan the development of LCK and the adjoining West Johor Strait.

sections.label: LCK Master Plan exhibition
sections.summary: SFA will launch the LCK Master Plan exhibition in the second half of 2023, showcasing some of these ideas.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Some of these ideas will be showcased in the LCK Master Plan exhibition, which SFA will launch in the second half of 2023.

sections.label: Joint study trip aquaculture
sections.summary: SFA plans a joint study trip this year with industry and academia to countries with advanced aquaculture production.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Miss Cheryl Chan asked how lessons from other countries with established aquaculture industries can be applied to our context.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We plan to conduct a joint study trip this year with industry and academia, to countries with advanced aquaculture production, to understand how they have managed to grow their commercial aquaculture sectors without negatively impacting marine biodiversity.

sections.label: AquaPolis launch
sections.summary: AquaPolis was launched in November 2022 to transform the aquaculture research landscape.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In November 2022, we launched AquaPolis to transform the aquaculture research landscape.

sections.label: Agriculture aquaculture training programmes
sections.summary: SFA and partners launched a 2022 Career Conversion Programme, and ITE will launch a Work-Study Diploma next month.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: For mid-career professionals, SFA partnered with Workforce Singapore and Republic Polytechnic in 2022 to launch a Career Conversion Programme to equip them with the knowledge and skills as Agri-tech Specialists or Agri-tech Operators.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: I am glad to announce that for Nitec and Higher Nitec graduates as well as in-service employees, a new Work-Study Diploma in Agriculture and Aquaculture Technology will be launched by ITE next month.

sections.label: 30 by 30 food goal
sections.summary: Singapore is pressing ahead with its 30 by 30 goal for local sustainable food production.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: To further strengthen our food resilience, we are pressing ahead with our "30 by 30" goal of building our agri-food industry’s capability to produce 30% of our nutritional needs locally and sustainably by 2030.

sections.label: Novel foods regulation funding
sections.summary: SFA approved cultured meat in 2020 and GOOD Meat's serum-free media, and will set aside $23 million for novel foods capabilities.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Since SFA approved the sale of cultured meat in 2020, a global first, we have seen a steady increase in applications for the sale of novel foods.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Most recently, SFA gave regulatory approval to GOOD Meat for the use of serum-free media in the production of cultivated meat.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We will set aside $23 million, under the Singapore Food Story R&D Programme 2.0, the national R&D programme for food, to build new food safety capabilities to cater to developments in the novel foods space.

sections.label: Sungei Kadut Lim Chu Kang study
sections.summary: PUB will start the next site-specific study for Sungei Kadut and Lim Chu Kang in the second half of this year.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: PUB will commence the next site-specific study for the Sungei Kadut and the Lim Chu Kang area in the second half of this year.

sections.label: Coastal Protection and Flood Management Research Programme
sections.summary: A new Coastal Protection and Flood Management Research Programme funded by the National Research Foundation will provide $125 million for research and collaboration.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: In addition to trade-offs, coastal protection is a long-term endeavour and requires new technologies and innovations, as Ms Poh Li San and Prof Koh Lian Pin had pointed out.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: I am pleased to announce that we will launch a new dedicated Coastal Protection and Flood Management Research Programme (CFRP), funded by the National Research Foundation, to strengthen long-term coastal protection and inland flood management capabilities in Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The CFRP will provide $125 million to foster research and collaboration across academia and the industry.

sections.label: CFRP Centre of Excellence at NUS
sections.summary: The CFRP will be anchored by a Centre of Excellence hosted by the National University of Singapore.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: The CFRP will be anchored by a Centre of Excellence, hosted by National University of Singapore (NUS).

sections.label: Drainage improvement works spending
sections.summary: Since 2011, the Government has invested around $2 billion on drainage improvement works.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Since 2011, the Government has invested around $2 billion on drainage improvement works.

sections.label: Coastal and Flood Protection Fund
sections.summary: The Coastal and Flood Protection Fund was set up in 2020 with an initial injection of $5 billion.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: One funding source is the Coastal and Flood Protection Fund, set up in 2020 with an initial injection of $5 billion.

sections.label: Dengue cases reported last year
sections.summary: Last year, more than 32,000 dengue cases were reported locally, the second highest in Singapore's recorded history.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: Last year, more than 32,000 dengue cases were reported locally, the second highest in Singapore’s recorded history.

sections.label: Wolbachia field study results
sections.summary: In Tampines, Yishun, Choa Chu Kang and Bukit Batok, releases over more than a year saw up to 98% drop in Aedes aegypti and up to 88% fewer dengue cases.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: In the initial field studies in Tampines, Yishun, Choa Chu Kang and Bukit Batok, where there have been more than one year of releases, we have observed up to 98% drop in the Aedes aegypti mosquito population and up to 88% reduction of dengue cases.

sections.label: Project Wolbachia pilot coverage
sections.summary: The expanded Project Wolbachia pilot now covers more than 300,000 households, about 30% of HDB blocks and 9% of landed homes.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: With the expansion last year, the Project Wolbachia pilot now covers more than 300,000 households, which is about 30% of all HDB blocks and 9% of all landed homes across Singapore.

sections.label: Slowing dengue transmission
sections.summary: Concerted efforts slowed dengue transmission from almost 40 cases a week at the peak to closure of the clusters.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: The concerted efforts helped to slow down the transmission of dengue infections from almost 40 cases a week at the peak, to the eventual successful closure of the clusters.

sections.label: Green Action for Communities launch
sections.summary: The Ministry, with MND and MCCY, launched the Green Action for Communities movement last year to cultivate a culture of sustainability.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: To cultivate a culture of sustainability within the community, my Ministry, together with the Ministry of National Development (MND) and Ministry of Culture, Community and Youth (MCCY), launched the Green Action for Communities (GAC) movement last year.

sections.label: Climate action activities rebranding
sections.summary: Activities including community events, workshops, talks, learning journeys, school and youth activities, clean-ups, promotions and green challenges aimed to raise climate change awareness and action; CAW is rebranded Go Green SG.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: The activities, which aimed to increase awareness of and spur action against climate change included community events, workshops, talks, learning journeys, school and youth activities, clean-ups, promotions, and green challenges.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: This year, we are excited to rebrand CAW as Go Green SG.

sections.label: Sustainable urban destination certification
sections.summary: Singapore has been certified a sustainable urban destination by the Global Sustainable Tourism Council, and Go Green SG will work with the Singapore Tourism Board to showcase sustainable experiences.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: As Minister of State Mr Alvin Tan announced, Singapore has been certified as a sustainable urban destination by the Global Sustainable Tourism Council.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: To strengthen our position as a sustainable urban destination, I am pleased to announce that Go Green SG we will be collaborating closely with the Singapore Tourism Board to showcase to the world the various sustainable experiences that Singapore has to offer.

sections.label: Grant call awards projects
sections.summary: The most recent grant call will award $2.4 million to 77 projects across various sectors and topics.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: For the most recent grant call, I am pleased to announce that $2.4 million will be awarded to 77 worthy projects that span various sectors and topics.

sections.label: SG Eco Fund awards
sections.summary: To date, 182 individuals and organisations have been awarded $9 million under the SG Eco Fund.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Parliamentary Secretary to the Minister for Sustainability and the Environment (Mr Baey Yam Keng)
sentences.text: To-date, 182 individuals and organisations have been awarded $9 million under SG Eco Fund.

sections.label: Pandan Reservoir environmental study
sections.summary: Before starting the Pandan Reservoir project, an appropriate environmental study will be done, as for Tengeh and Bedok.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: On Pandan Reservoir, I would like to assure Members that before we embark on the project, we will do the appropriate environmental study, just as we have done for Tengeh, and also for Bedok.

sections.label: New institution involving IHLs
sections.summary: NUS may host the new set-up, which will involve other IHLs, NTU research institutions and A*STAR institutions.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: While NUS may serve as a host for this new set-up, it will be an institution that will involve other institutions of higher learning (IHLs), other research institutions from NTU and the Agency for Science, Technology and Research (A*STAR) institutions as well.

sections.label: Mosquito coverage and supply
sections.summary: Coverage is about 30% of HDB blocks and 9% of landed homes, needing five million mosquitoes weekly, and full Singapore coverage would need 15 to 20 million weekly.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Right now, we are covering about 30% of HDB blocks but just 9% of landed homes; and we already need five million mosquitoes every week.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: So, imagine if we cover the whole of Singapore, we will easily need about 15 to 20 million mosquitoes a week.

sections.label: Climate services hub ecosystem
sections.summary: As Singapore pursues being a climate services hub, it is seeding its ecosystem of sustainability solutions providers by welcoming and working with international partners.

sentences.speaker: Prof Koh Lian Pin
sentences.text: As Singapore pursues our ambition to be a climate services hub, we are seeding our ecosystem of sustainability solutions providers by welcoming and working with international partners.

sections.label: Climate protection and flood management centre
sections.summary: A newly announced climate protection and flood management centre is located in NUS with anchors in various IHLs.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: I think the example that Senior Minister of State Koh Poh Koon has mentioned earlier about the climate protection and flood management centre that we have just announced is a very clear illustration of how we intend to do that.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: It is a centre that is located in NUS, with strong anchors – not just in NUS but in various IHLs that have capabilities in related issues.

sections.label: Coastal protection, PhD projects, Green Skills Committee
sections.summary: Coastal protection is a multi-billion-dollar, multi-decade undertaking involving student projects, international collaboration, and a new Green Skills Committee.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Senior Minister of State Koh Poh Koon has also talked about how we intend to engage students in PhD projects and also in the Masters project to ensure that we have sufficient people in the pipeline to enable us to undertake this project that is going to be massive, that is going to be huge, that is going to be significant and at the same time, it is going to take many decades.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: It is going to be a multi-billion-dollar and multi-decade undertaking, just as we have done for the water security story, the coastal protection part of it is going to be a new area where we expect international collaboration, foreign ideas and innovations that we should be open to accept, while at the same time, finding our own local applications that is relevant and cost-effective to us.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: I would also like to just refer Members to what has been announced under the MTI COS debate, that a Green Skills Committee will be set up to look at creating greater capabilities and developing more expertise in the areas of sustainability and green economy.

sections.label: Hawker centre rentals about 9%
sections.summary: Senior Minister of State Khor said hawker centre stall rentals are only about 9% of cooked food costs and prices.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: I am glad that Senior Minister of State Khor has told us that the rentals do not make up the bulk of the cost and prices of cooked food for the stalls in hawker centres.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: I think she mentioned that it is only about 9%.

sections.label: Hawker rentals 9% of operating cost
sections.summary: Based on an October 2022 survey, rentals form about 9% of hawkers' total operating cost.

sentences.speaker: Miss Cheryl Chan Wei Ling
sentences.text: Given now that the runway to 2030 is not very long, how confident are we that all these will be able to meet the targets that we set for 2030?

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: As I have said, based on our last survey in October 2022, rentals form about 9% of the hawkers' total operating cost.

sections.label: Fair hawker rents, no subletting
sections.summary: Reserved rent, subletting and assignment were done away with so hawker stall rents are fair but not speculative.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Having said that, we are mindful that we must create a good environment for the hawkers, making sure that the rents are fair but not speculative.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: This is the reason why we have done away with reserved rent, so that people can bid for as low as $1.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Individuals bid according to what they think they can pay and the competition, and so on.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: We have also done away with subletting and assignment so that you remove this real estate play from hawker stall rentals.

sections.label: Recirculating aquaculture and egg farms
sections.summary: A recirculating aquaculture system can yield 10 to 15 times more than open sea cages, and Singapore may meet 30% of egg requirements.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: By using a recirculating aquaculture system, for example, the productivity and the yield can be up to 10 or 15 times more than an sea open cage.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: Today, we have three egg farms and a fourth one on the way.

sentences.speaker: Dr Koh Poh Koon
sentences.text: We are able to probably close the gap and meet 30% of our egg requirements in Singapore.

sections.label: Disposable carrier bag charge
sections.summary: Charging for disposable carrier bags starts 3 July 2023 to nudge people to think before taking a bag and reduce its use.

sentences.speaker: Ms Grace Fu Hai Yien
sentences.text: Members can be assured that we will want to go as quickly as we can.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: I have just announced that we are going to start charging on 3 July 2023, Monday.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: But having said that, the issue is not about charging for disposable carrier bags.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: The idea of doing this is to nudge a change in behaviour, to get people to think more before they take that bag, to reduce their use; and if possible, even not to use it.

sections.label: No workgroup, tobacco tax
sections.summary: There are no plans to set up such a workgroup, and MOF increased tobacco tax to reduce smoking prevalence, initiation and encourage cessation.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: What is important is we need to be able to find or identify that technological means to enforce it.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: Therefore, we currently have no plans to set up such a workgroup.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: And as I have also noted, just two days ago, that we have also been working on upstream efforts, multi-Ministry.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: So, the Ministry of Finance (MOF) increased tax on tobacco, we hope that that will help to further reduce smoking prevalence, smoking initiation, and encourage smoking cessation.

sections.label: Supermarket bag charge proceeds
sections.summary: Supermarket operators agreed to use bag charge proceeds for environmental and social causes, with HDB estates the primary interest for dengue protection.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: With regards to supermarket operators, we are already engaging the supermarket operators.

sentences.speaker: Dr Amy Khor Lean Suan
sentences.text: I have just announced that all the supermarket operators have already agreed that they are going to use the proceeds from the bag charge for environmental and social causes.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Indeed, I think for us to cover all residential premises, private condominiums will be part of it.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Currently, we are looking at releases twice a week.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: But at the moment, we are looking at how we can put our resources to bring benefits to more people.

sentences.speaker: Mr Baey Yam Keng
sentences.text: Therefore, HDB estates will be our primary interest, because with that, we are able to scale-up, hopefully we can scale-up and then protect more people from dengue.

sections.label: Withdrawal of amendment
sections.summary: The Member begs leave to withdraw his amendment.

sentences.speaker: Mr Louis Ng Kok Kwang
sentences.text: With that, Sir, I beg leave to withdraw my amendment.
